mapper.select: SELECT id FROM theme WHERE is_default = 1

SELECT t.id, t.theme_name, t.price, t.thumbnail_url, t.theme_code,
CASE WHEN tp.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_owned, CASE WHEN m.theme_id = t.id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_applied
FALSE AS is_owned, FALSE AS is_applied
FROM theme t
LEFT JOIN theme_purchase tp ON tp.theme_id = t.id AND tp.member_id = #{memberId} AND tp.purchase_status = TRUE LEFT JOIN member m ON m.id = #{memberId}
WHERE t.status = 'ON_SALE'
AND t.theme_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM theme t WHERE t.status = 'ON_SALE'
AND t.theme_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_purchase (member_id, theme_id, payment_id, is_used) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{themeId}, NULL, TRUE)
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.theme_name, t.price, t.thumbnail_url, t.theme_code, TRUE AS is_owned, CASE WHEN m.theme_id = t.id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_applied FROM theme_purchase tp INNER JOIN theme t ON t.id = tp.theme_id INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = tp.member_id WHERE tp.member_id = #{memberId} AND tp.purchase_status = TRUE ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM theme_purchase tp INNER JOIN theme t ON t.id = tp.theme_id WHERE tp.member_id = #{memberId} AND tp.purchase_status = TRUE
SELECT t.id AS id, t.theme_code AS themeCode, t.css_text AS cssText, t.is_default AS isDefault FROM theme t WHERE t.id = #{themeId}
